components.label: Evaluation Studio
components.sublabel: Frozen predictions and independent ground truth

cards.title: Browser and API
items: Upload and pixel limits precede image normalization
API returns no-store previews and Unicode JPEG annotations
Browser generates JPEG and CSV downloads

cards.title: Enrollment and recognition
items: Gallery SCRFD retries zero detections at 640 px
Review and correction use immutable reference IDs
Group photos use one detection pass, cosine matching and conflict resolution

cards.title: Startup and switching
items: SCRFD + AdaFace is the preferred research configuration
YuNet + SFace is the automatic fallback when available
Switching restores only the selected pipeline’s cached gallery

cards.title: Independent evaluation
items: Manual correspondence or local CSV and JSON import
Gallery membership is resolved against the frozen snapshot
One-to-one IoU matching and separate detection and recognition metrics
Evaluation reports never feed back into inference
